name: VAIDEHI CHAUDHARI
bio:
Career Overview: Vaidehi Chaudhari is an up-and-coming Indian tennis player gaining recognition on the ITF circuit.

Playing Style: Known for her all-court game, blending defensive resilience with timely aggression, particularly effective on hard courts.
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Yet to qualify for a Grand Slam main draw; building experience in ITF tournaments.

Notable Achievements:
  • Won 1 ITF singles title and reached several semifinals and finals in $15K and $25K events.

Other Highlights:
  • A consistent performer in Indian ITF events, Vaidehi is working to break into the top 300 and establish herself internationally.

Vaidehi's dedication marks her as a player to watch in Indian women's tennis.
